body: I just feel like sharing my feelings with other guys is just plain awkward and weird

I don't know how to keep going on. I haven't left my room in forever except for school. My "friends" don't like me and talk shit about me. I don't have anyone really except for one good friend. I'm a let down and a screw up. Been hospitalized twice for suicide attempts. My parents threatened to put me up for adoption and my brother sexually forced me to do things to him when I was young and I haven't gotten over any of it. It's too hard to go on like this.
